dogecoin.text: Elon: "I own Bitcoin, Tesla owns Bitcoin, I also own Ethereum and Dogecoin."

@Izzeus502 CoinMarketCap "accidentally" had the market cap wrong, which pushed XRP down the list. 

CoinMarketCap is owned by Binance, and this "error" just so happened to rank "Binance Coin" firmly in between DogeCoin and Ethereum, which were the most hyped at that time.

Fun fact: The GME breakout and YOLO of 2021 took place 1,102 days after the peak of Dogecoin in 2018.

The GME breakout of 2024 took place 1,100 days after the peak of Dogecoin in 2021. https://t.co/zL2RCqkVBN
